data.action: 独坐于木桌前单手托腮，身旁放着琥珀色烈酒杯与昏黄马灯
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, 中景平视，木桌、酒杯与人物构成视觉三角
data.description: 旧港昏暗嘈杂的酒馆角落里，斯卡蒂独自坐在粗木方桌前。桌面上一盏防风马灯散发着昏黄光晕，烈酒杯中琥珀色酒液轻晃。她单手托腮，静静听着水手们粗俗的笑骂与远处浪涛，眼神淡漠却透着审视。
data.lighting: 桌角防风马灯散发的暖黄色微弱顶光与环境阴影
data.location: 沿海旧港地下酒馆角落
data.promptProse: Tucked into the dimly lit corner of a rustic coastal tavern, Skadi sits alone at a scarred wooden table resting her chin in one hand. An amber glass of liquor sits beside a brass hurricane lantern that casts warm golden light across her quiet, observant expression amidst deep tavern shadows.
data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 海港酒馆的昏黄独酌
data.animaCaption: Resting her chin in one hand beside a brass lantern and a glass on the wooden tavern table, she observes quietly in the warm dim light.
